notes.title: Genetic Fluff Update - Version 0.9.0 Released
notes.notes:
Genetic Fluff's final release is coming soon and the goal is to release before the end of this year 2025.
Many general updates have made it into this release including a new 'dark spider' creature.

notes.title: Genetic Fluff Major Update - Version 0.8.0 Released!
notes.notes:
[b]Genetic Fluff is approaching a stable full release.[/b]

[b]Version 0.8.0 is a major update and there were many gameplay, stability and useability updates:[/b]
[list]
[*] Game input has been simplified and streamlined.  Now when attacking the joy direction dictates which attack (high, middle, low) is used.
[*] Sound Menu now allows you to change the music tracks.
[*] Each main character (Elio, Aster, Sten, Ada) animations now have blocking and blocking walking animations.
[*] Many bugs have been fixed and after a complete play-though of the current game, everything seems to be currently working.
[/list]
[b]What is left to finish before complete release:[/b]
[list]
[*] A few more levels to add to the end of the game.
[*] Some story dialog to write.
[*] Animations for special attacks to be created.
[/list]

notes.title: Genetic Fluff Release Version 0.7.2
notes.notes:
The new release of Genetic Fluff version 0.7.2 has many bug fixes and gameplay updates:
[list]
[*] Controller/keyboard menu input fixes.
[*] High, middle and low attacks are now based on the players joystick direction.  Where the attack was previously calculated based on the opponent you are attacking.
[*] HUD improvements, including text size updates.
[*] Godot Engine updates, currently on 4.1.3 stable.
[*] And many more bug fixes and general improvements to gameplay.
[/list]

notes.title: Genetic Fluff Early Access Game Update!
notes.notes:
This is probably the largest update Genetic Fluff has undergone since entering Early Access.

0.7.0.0 release includes:
[list]
[*] Character Updates (added new player animations and attacks!)
[*] Character Navigation Improvements (added navigation avoidance, enemy clustering etc.)
[*] Level Updates (play testing, fine-tuning)
[*] Dialog Updates (refined story dialog for new/exiting levels)
[*] Menu Improvements (streamlined the UI menu useability)
[*] HUD Improvements (added additional HUD features for readability etc.)
[*] Game Engine Upgrade (upgraded to Godot Engine 4.1 from Godot Engine 3.5)
[*] and many more improvement and updates included...
[/list]

notes.title: Genetic Fluff Version 0.6.3.0 released!
notes.notes:
Genetic Fluff version 0.6.3.0 updates:
[list]
[*] Gameplay changes and improvements to simplify and controller input.  
[*] Attacking is now one button instead of three.  Items can be used without entering the item menu.   
[*] Charging attack was removed and has been replaced with easy to use one button attacking.  
[*] See the Genetic Fluff main product page for new controller mapping.
[*] Camera split screen has been removed and replaced with auto-zooming.
[*] Many bugs have also been fixed including AI and pathfinding issues.
[/list]
